51549440.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to full length His-tagged beta-catenin (1 to 781 residues) (unknown origin) expressed in Escherichia coli DE3 by surface plasmon resonance assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface Plasmon Resonance Assay: β-catenin protein was immobilized on CM5 chip (GE health) by using Biacore T200. Sensorgrams were obtained using Biacore with a series of quercetin derivatives of different concentrations (40000, 20000, 10000, 5000, 2500, 1250, 625, 312.5, 156.25, 78.125, 39.0625, 19.53 and 9.76 nM). The correlation time interval of SPR sensor map was 60 s, and the separation time interval was 60 s. The data were analyzed using Biacore evaluation software.
original_paragraph.Figure 4 caption: Fig. 4. Sensorgram and saturation curve of the titration of C1 (A) and quercetin (B) on β-catenin-FL immobilized on a CM5 chip. (C)The binding curve was fit to get Kd values of 1.23 μM and 5.58 μM respectively. Data were calculated by using Biacore T200 software.
